versions.changelog:
3d-printing-generator v1.0.1

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional changes to APIs or logic; update is limited to house-keeping/documentation cleanup.

3d-printing-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the 3D Printing Toy Generator skill.
- Provides APIs to generate toy design drafts, multi-view sheets, and 3D models from text/image prompts.
- Supports multiple toy templates: figurine, stuffed toy, 3D print, game asset, and architecture.
- Integrates with OneKey Agent Gateway by Craftsman Agent; access key required.
- Includes options for asset size, model provider, and workspace organization.
